title: mentha arvensis var. sativa
intro: Mentha arvensis var. sativa, commonly known as wild spearmint, is a variant of the spearmint plant that grows in the wild and is native to Europe and Asia. This herb is known for its numerous health benefits, including digestive aid, reducing nausea and vomiting, and easing respiratory issues such as congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of wild spearmint include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce pain, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of wild spearmint include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
